name: mk-tax-overview
description: North Macedonia tax routing for calendar year 2026. Use for an initial North Macedonia tax overview, choosing the right income-tax, company-tax, payroll, social-insurance, VAT, transfer-pricing or cross-border skill. Covers individuals, sole traders, resident companies, local permanent establishments, employers and VAT taxpayers. Identifies the primary charging laws, the different annual filing routes and the July 2026 contribution-rate change without substituting a headline rate for the actual category computation. This is a supporting router to the seven computational skills, not an additional computational tax domain. Read the linked skill and its scope and unresolved items before preparing a calculation. Checked against the law (tier 2) and awaiting licensed North Macedonia professional review.
